_comment: Iter 1, Phase 1 — attn_wavenet (cache miss, bad score -1.509).
key_findings: Best score of -1.509 is far below the wavenet seed baseline of 5.576.
Training collapsed in round 1 and only partially recovered by round 3.
bottlenecks: Attention mechanism conflicts with dilated causal convolution backbone.
Insufficient data (trial_portion=0.1) to stabilise the new parameters.
best_config_analysis: No hyperparameter setting overcame the architectural conflict.
frequency_analysis: All 20 files scored below 0. Architecture uniformly fails.
data_sensitivity: Score improved 0.87 when trial_portion doubled — data-starved.
efficiency_assessment: More parameters than wavenet, 7 points worse. Poor trade-off.
strategy_assessment: Did not try removing the problematic attention mechanism.

_comment: Iter 1, Phase 1 — punet (cache miss, seed model).
key_findings: Stable at 1.29 — establishes a low-performance baseline.
Skip connections help mid-frequency files (5-9) but not low-frequency.
bottlenecks: No temporal context — purely spatial U-Net architecture.
Fixed downsampling loses temporal resolution irreversibly.
best_config_analysis: depth=3 is the best config; deeper nets score worse due to gradient issues.
score_trend: Flat after round 1. No meaningful improvement over 2 rounds.
frequency_analysis: Files 5-9 score 1.5-2.0. Files 0-4 near zero. Files 10-19 near zero.
data_sensitivity: Low — score unchanged when trial_portion increased.
efficiency_assessment: Lightweight model (0.8M params) but poor score. Not worth scaling.
strategy_assessment: Architecture family exhausted. U-Net approach not suited for this task.

_comment: Iter 1, Phase 1 — wavenet (cache miss, seed model, SOTA).
key_findings: SOTA at 5.576 — wide receptive field from dilated causal convolutions is key.
High-frequency files 15-19 score 7-9. Low-frequency files 0-4 score near zero.
bottlenecks: Structural low-frequency blind spot: causal convolutions miss very long-range patterns.
Score plateau at round 3 — current architecture has converged.
best_config_analysis: num_layers=6 with focal loss is optimal. More layers add instability.
frequency_analysis: Files 15-19 score 7-9. Files 5-14 score 3-6. Files 0-4 score near 0.
efficiency_assessment: Best score-per-parameter across all seed models. Pareto-dominant.
strategy_assessment: Spectral augmentation or multi-rate processing could address low-freq gap.

key_findings: Wavenet (5.576) is the clear SOTA. attn_wavenet collapsed — attention destabilised the backbone.
Universal low-frequency blind spot: files 0-4 near zero for all models.
bottlenecks: Low-frequency blindness is structural, not a per-model tuning issue.
Adding non-convolutional mechanisms naively breaks the dilated causal backbone.
frequency_comparison: Files 0-4 near zero across all models. Files 15-19 good only for wavenet.
efficiency_comparison: Wavenet Pareto-dominant. attn_wavenet and punet worse on both axes.
take_home_message: Spectral-domain processing is the most promising direction to address the low-frequency gap without destabilising the wavenet backbone.
